title: Task Submitted Response
description: The submitted branch of a task response: the task acknowledgement, optional advisory errors, and the echoed context. The task's result arrives through get_task_status or a webhook, not in this envelope.

errors.description: Optional advisory errors accompanying the submitted envelope. Use only for non-blocking warnings (e.g., throttled_severity advisories, governance observations). Terminal failures belong in the error branch, not here.
